key_insight: A hybrid TFT–N-BEATS model combines short-term dynamics with long-term patterns to improve multi-horizon photovoltaic power forecasting.
engineering_relevance: More accurate PV forecasts can support grid stability, energy scheduling, and coordinated PV–battery–grid operation.
method: TFT learns short-term temporal dependencies and dynamic feature importance.
N-BEATS decomposes long-term trends and seasonality.
Adaptive attention fuses both branches to forecast 30 minutes, 2 hours, 6 hours, 12 hours, and 24 hours ahead.
evidence_signal: On multi-year DKASC datasets, the abstract reports RMSE values of 42.35–52.29, a 35–40% reduction versus TFT, and MAPE below 5% across all datasets.
watch_item: RMSE units and horizon-specific results are not provided in the abstract; the work addresses PV forecasting rather than perovskite cell materials or device performance.
paper_title: A Hybrid TFT-NBEATS Framework for Robust Multi-Horizon Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
